settings.name: Nandita Dental Clinic
settings.emergencyNote: For urgent dental pain or emergencies during clinic hours, please visit our clinic in Hubli-Dharwad directly.
settings.aboutText: Nandita Dental Clinic provides dedicated, compassionate oral healthcare in Hubli-Dharwad under the expert clinical guidance of Dr. Prasannakumar Kadakol. We blend modern clinical precision, prosthodontic mastery, and an unhurried, gentle environment designed to make every dental visit stress-free.
settings.missionText: To preserve natural smiles through conservative dentistry, superior prosthodontic care, and uncompromised sterilisation standards.

doctors.name: Dr. Prasannakumar Kadakol
doctors.bio: Specialist in Dentistry and Prosthodontics providing comprehensive care including restorative crown & bridge work, painless root canal procedures, and aesthetic smile maintenance at Nandita Dental Clinic.

treatments.title: Root Canal Treatment
treatments.shortDesc: Painless endodontic therapy to eliminate deep infection and save your natural tooth.
treatments.fullDesc: Modern rotary endodontic treatment designed to thoroughly cleanse infected pulp tissue, disinfect the canal spaces, and hermetically seal the tooth structure, relieving pain and preventing extraction.
details: Painless procedure with advanced local anesthesia
Preserves original tooth roots and bite alignment
Protective ceramic or composite crown placement

treatments.title: Teeth Cleaning
treatments.shortDesc: Ultrasonic scaling and polishing to remove stubborn calculus and protect gum health.
treatments.fullDesc: Routine preventative dental prophylaxis that removes supra-gingival and sub-gingival plaque, tartar deposits, and external stains. Essential for preventing periodontal disease and bad breath.
details: Targeted stain removal and air polishing

treatments.title: Teeth Whitening
treatments.shortDesc: Safe, in-office cosmetic whitening to brighten your smile several shades naturally.
treatments.fullDesc: Clinical enamel-safe whitening designed to eliminate stubborn deep discoloration caused by tea, coffee, aging, or fluorosis, restoring a bright, youthful, and luminous smile.
details: Visible shade improvement in single session
Protective barrier applied to gums and soft tissues

treatments.title: Dental Fillings
treatments.shortDesc: Aesthetic, tooth-colored composite restorations that restore chipped or decayed teeth.
treatments.fullDesc: Biocompatible composite resin fillings that bond seamlessly to natural tooth structure, repairing dental caries, chips, and minor fractures while matching the exact shade of adjacent enamel.
details: Instant bite checking and smooth contouring

treatments.title: Prosthodontic Care
treatments.shortDesc: Expert restoration and replacement of missing teeth using crowns, bridges, and prosthetics.
treatments.fullDesc: Specialized prosthodontic therapy delivered by Dr. Prasannakumar Kadakol, focused on restoring lost masticatory function, bite equilibrium, and facial aesthetics through precision-engineered prostheses.
details: Fixed dental bridges for missing gaps
Bite equilibration and TMJ comfort assessment
